title: Introduce deferred KMS consent handshake and audit-forward sampler
author: Noah Chen
description: Motivation: customers requested a non-blocking KMS consent flow for tenant onboarding and cross-region failover that preserves auditability without impacting tail latency. This PR implements a deferred consent handshake for KMS-bound operations and couples it with an audit-forward sampler to reduce load on the audit pipeline while guaranteeing eventual proof-of-consent. Design summary: (1) A consent-handshake middleware that returns an immediate 202 Accepted for operations when tenant consent is configurable-asynchronous, emits a consent-token header to downstream services, and enqueues a consent verification task for background processing. (2) A KMS affinity gate that consults RBAC v2 temporal grants to decide if a synchronous KMS operation is still required, otherwise defers and routes to a helper queuer. (3) An audit-forward sampler which buffers high-frequency audit events from deferred flows and forwards deterministic, sampled envelopes to the main audit sink with provenance headers to reconstruct the full sequence if needed. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged; the feature is behind a per-tenant flag (tenant.features.deferred_kms_consent) and an env toggle (KMS_CONSENT_DEFER_ENABLED=false). Rollout plan: enable in internal staging, run with 10% of production tenants for 48h, validate no increase in P99 latency or token leakage, then staged 25/50/100% rollout with canary keys. Testing: unit tests for middleware and sampler state machine, integration tests emulate KMS provider delays and verify audit envelope reconstruction in tests/integration/test_kms_consent.py, end-to-end manual verification checklist included. Security review: includes threat model and mitigation section in docs/security/residency-consent.md describing attacker vectors for consent token replay and how TTL+nonce and signed provenance headers prevent misuse. Performance: added benchmarks in benchmark-lab/kms-consent/ showing <1ms median added latency for synchronous path and bounded queue tail under burst. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked [x] Unit tests added [x] Integration tests added [x] Docs updated [x] Security reviewed [x] Smoke tested. Release notes: Adds an opt-in deferred KMS consent mode and an audit-forward sampler to reduce audit ingestion load for deferred flows. Related: ENG-5932 covers UX for tenant whitelisting. Merge method: squash. CI notes: initial lint failure due to goimports ordering; fixed in follow-up commit. Production monitoring: added metrics kms.consent.deferred.count, kms.consent.reconcile.failures, audit.sampler.forwarded_envelopes. Deploy notes: helm toggle chart value redwood.kms.deferConsent.enabled=false by default.
